title: Strategy advisor
intro: You're booking a strategy session. A short set of context questions comes before payment.
bio: I work with founders on hard strategic decisions — pricing, positioning, and the messy choices between them. Most clients come to me before a fundraise, a pivot, or a launch.

title: Leadership & career coach
intro: You're booking a coaching session. A few quick questions help your coach prepare before payment.
bio: I coach managers and founders through the moments that matter — a new role, a hard conversation, a stuck team. We start from where you are and build a plan you'll actually keep.

title: Workshop instructor
intro: You're booking with the studio. Pick a session — group workshops show how many spots are left.
bio: I run small, hands-on workshops where people actually get to practise, not just watch. Groups stay capped so everyone gets attention and leaves with something they can use.
